notes: Fixed a crash that could occur when the app was closed or stopped — the app no longer tries to start a service in the background.
The floating pen is removed cleanly when you close the app.
Android downloads use versioned file names, so you always get the newest APK.
The app fits every phone screen, with a back button and Android back-key navigation.
Manual 'Check for app update' in Settings shows your installed version and the available one.
Only one floating pen, and the quick-capture window follows the pen wherever you drag it.
